comparison.objective: Fit a spring tension rod level between walls; candidate depins a connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compression, span alignment, and controlled release versus recessed tool insertion and retained-contact extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Rod self-supports level in the marked band for 4 seconds versus terminal exits its cavity and all protected parts remain intact for 3 seconds.
comparison.reason: Both involve spring retention, but one tests fitting a spanning member while the other tests selective release of internal locking tangs.
